scope: Independent source rereview of worker boundary corrections plus tightly scoped raw-configuration-discovery regression fix. No producer query, Cargo invocation or qualification/reserved access by reviewer.

baseline.read_with: git show exact baseline, never current modified TS source

findings.mechanism: Initial source calculated captured_repository_input_id from files after SDK entries were inserted, so the named repository identity varied with SDK contents.
findings.status: CORRECTED_SOURCE; identity computed from repository-only files before SDK insertion. Owned DEV test checks exact independently authored repository descriptor digest; author GREEN4/4 log inspected.

findings.mechanism: canonical_path is serialized directly from native PathBuf; on Windows this uses backslashes. The prepared independent worker read join expects canonicalized path with slash replacement. All Windows worker provenance joins would reject despite otherwise matching bytes.
findings.status: CORRECTED_SOURCE; canonical_path explicitly slash-normalized like path. Native Windows runtime remains NOT_RUN.

findings.mechanism: Protocol allows duplicate root paths. Producer extracts once per list entry, duplicating modules and facts; baseline iterates unique program source files filtered through rootSet. Duplicated modules are then rejected by the actual response consumer.
findings.status: CORRECTED_SOURCE; extracted_roots deduplicates fs.key(path), and actual duplicate-root extraction is compared with single-root extraction. Relevant RED duplication log and subsequent author GREEN4/4 inspected.

findings.mechanism: Baseline request shape accepts relative path strings and resolves them through native cwd. Producer relative_source_path normalizes a relative root directly to slash-rooted key, refusing a cwd-relative file inside the repository. Independent consumer already supports relative native job paths.
findings.status: CORRECTED_SOURCE; absolute_worker_path maps empty string to dot, uses native absolute plus TS normalize_path, and is called by repository root, roots and emit. DEV includes empty helper equals current cwd assertion. Prior nonempty relative RED/GREEN retained. Final integrated execution is pending.

positive_static_observations: Malformed worker request is parsed before SDK read in additional_observation; malformed_request and run share parse_request. Request carrier and current executable are still read, so no absence-of-all-OS-reads claim is made.

Malformed schema returns unbound job, ok=false, extraction_started=false before repository/compiler access. Well-formed requests failing SDK/repository/setup return bound job with extraction_started tracking whether compiler invocation began.
Consumer mode reads no SDK and uses lexical native path operations without repository filesystem reads.

Response shape, ownership, canonical optional target validation, marker/kind/line checks, optional-null refusal, exact unique emit modules, and well-formed worker-failure distinction match inspected baseline. Baseline quirks are preserved, including ignored extra fields and outside emit ownership; structural acceptance is not confinement or authorization.

Worker raw bytes and decoded text hashes are recorded from actual sequential filesystem reads; explicit capture claim denies atomic live acquisition. Compiler reads are separately reported as probes; no supplied-SDK-equals-consumed claim.

New frontendCapabilityObservation records actual requested roots loaded/parse diagnostics, workspace issues and resolution errors rather than introducing an invented complete boolean. Final integrated check remains pending.

configuration_discovery.finding: No certain defect in this bounded delta. Baseline findConfigFile probes raw system before workspaceLinkedSystem; candidate now probes captured raw key presence before applying the retained containment refusal and wrapped read boundary.
configuration_discovery.actual_path: configuration::inspect uses files.contains_key(fs.key(candidate)), records configuration_discovery_file_exists, tests contained(config) before fs.read_file(config); ConfigurationFs::read_file retains repository confinement for inheritance.
configuration_discovery.claim_limit: The presence probe is an observation over caller-supplied captured metadata. It neither reads an outside config content nor accesses ambient OS; it does not establish live filesystem absence or atomic capture.
